name: web-vite-sri3
description: Vite + React app covering the @posthog/rollup-plugin x vite-plugin-sri3 incompatibility: sri3 computes integrity hashes from the in-memory chunks in generateBundle, and up to @posthog/rollup-plugin 1.4.7 the plugin mutated the emitted .js files on disk in writeBundle, so the served files no longer matched the hashes and the browser blocked every script. Fixed in 1.4.9, which injects the chunk id in renderChunk (in-memory, before sri3 hashes) — expect MATCH. Pin @posthog/rollup-plugin to 1.4.7 to reproduce the original failure.

scripts.start: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm verify && pnpm serve
